summary: Re-entry build week: reintroduce sweet-spot cycling quality and easy aerobic volume after two zero weeks, conservative load with strong recovery markers

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride
sessions.focus: Aerobic base development — Z2 time to drive mitochondrial density and fat oxidation without CNS cost

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, build cadence to 85–90 rpm, HR climbing gently toward 140 bpm
Z2 steady aerobic — 106–141W, 85–90 rpm, HR 146–162 bpm, conversational effort throughout
Easy spin, reduce resistance, let HR drift back below 125 bpm

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot Intervals 3x5min
sessions.focus: Aerobic power development — sweet-spot at 88–93% FTP drives threshold adaptation with manageable recovery cost

steps.description: Progressive spin: 3 min Z1 at 88–105W, then 2 min building to low Z2 at 110–120W, cadence 85–90 rpm, HR targeting ~145 bpm
Sweet-spot — 155–165W (88–93% FTP), 90 rpm, HR 160–172 bpm by end of rep, comfortably hard but sustainable
Z1 easy spin recovery — 60–90W, let HR drop back toward 140 bpm before next rep
Easy spin down, reduce resistance progressively, HR below 125 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Shoulder Safe
sessions.focus: Posterior chain and single-leg stability — hip extension power and knee stability transferable to cycling and running, no shoulder loading
sessions.notes: 2 rounds of circuit: 12x Goblet Squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg each hand, 10x TRX Split Squat per leg, 15x Banded Glute Bridge, 8x Dead Bug per side. 60 sec rest between rounds. RIR 2–3 on every set. Shoulder stays unloaded throughout.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral 10 each side, hip circles 10 each direction, bodyweight squats 10 reps slow and controlled — activate hips, glutes, hamstrings
2 rounds: Goblet Squat 12x16kg → RDL 10x16kg → TRX Split Squat 10/leg → Banded Glute Bridge 15x → Dead Bug 8/side. 60 sec rest between rounds
Hip flexor stretch 30s each side, seated hamstring stretch 30s each side, figure-four glute stretch 30s each side

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Running pattern maintenance and aerobic conditioning — Z1–Z2 easy effort preserves run fitness and reinforces aerobic base without adding fatigue

steps.description: 3 min walk then 2 min easy jog building into Z1 pace — >7:00/km, HR below 145 bpm, relaxed and easy
Z1–Z2 easy continuous run — 6:15–7:00/km, HR 145–162 bpm. Conversational effort. If HR exceeds 162, slow the pace. Relaxed shoulders, easy arm swing.
Easy walk to bring HR below 120 bpm before stopping

summary: Progressive build: extend sweet-spot to 4 reps, add a second easy cycling day, maintain run and strength — first meaningful TSS step up in the cycle

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic volume — extend duration to 25 min main set

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot Intervals 4x5min
sessions.focus: Aerobic power development — 4th rep added to build threshold capacity

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Progress Load
sessions.focus: Posterior chain strength — progress to 20kg goblet squat, add 3rd round if tolerated

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Running pattern maintenance and aerobic conditioning — extend main set to 25 min

summary: Peak week: introduce longer sweet-spot reps (6–7 min) on the bike and a short threshold run — highest intensity stimulus of the block

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic volume — 28 min main set, fat oxidation and aerobic conditioning

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot Long Reps 3x7min
sessions.focus: Peak aerobic power — longer sweet-spot reps deepen threshold adaptation

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Full 3 Rounds
sessions.focus: Strength endurance — 3 rounds at progressed loads, peak tissue stimulus

sessions.name: Easy Run with Strides
sessions.focus: Running neuromuscular sharpening — Z2 run with 4x20s strides at end

summary: Recovery week: cut volume ~45%, easy intensities only — let the adaptations from the build-peak block consolidate before the next cycle

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Active recovery — Z1 only, flush legs, maintain movement without adding load

sessions.name: Mobility & Light Activation
sessions.focus: Tissue maintenance — reduced volume (1 round), bodyweight focus, keep movement quality

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Run
sessions.focus: Running pattern maintenance at Z1 — short, easy, no pressure

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Light Z2 aerobic volume — round out the recovery week without stressing the system
